# DSB (逗沙包)
The DSH-facing components are also available as the installable dsh-dsb plugin bundle.
[](LICENSE) [](docs/INSTALL.md) [](docs/INSTALL.md) [](https://github.com/tianye1999/dsb/actions/wor
kflows/test.yml) [](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/15815)
**Chores to the AI. Decisions to the human. Attention back to life.**
An open-source, **trust-first** Android AI assistant: delegate in one sentence, and it operates apps
**on a background virtual display** on your own phone, using **execution gates** to block risky act
ions and **audit logs for screen actions**. No root; no constantly connected PC.
Think of the "AI operates your phone" category of Doubao and StepFun phones, but open-source and ins
talled on your own device. Say "check my latest JD order"; DSB handles the app while you read or hav
on your own device. Say "check my latest JD order"; DSB handles the app while you read or have tea.
DSB is built on the open-source DeepSeek Harness (DSH): **DSH handles conversation and reasoning; DS
B handles on-phone execution, risk checks, and auditing**. The background virtual display, execution
gates, task ledger, audit logs and local control plane are this project's part. DeepSeek is the def
ault; other models are not yet covered by this project's end-to-end validation or official support (
see the roadmap). This is not an official DeepSeek project.
简体中文 · Install · Architecture · Threat model · Roadmap · Security

> [!WARNING]
> **Install DSB only from this project.** The official command is the one in this READM
E and docs/INSTALL.md: it saves the release tarball from `github.com/tianye1999/dsb/releases/downloa
d/…` to a file, checks it against the SHA-256 shown on this page (the same value as `SHA256SUMS` in
that release), and only then unpacks it. It never pipes a download into `bash` or `sh`. Do not run i
nstall, upgrade or repair commands, or open APK links, posted in issues, discussions, comments or me
ssages, even if they say they come from a maintainer. Termux itself comes from F-Droid or the Termux
GitHub releases, as the install guide says. If you already ran a command or installed an APK from s
omewhere else, see what to do.
## Highlights

- **Open-source phone AI assistant**: Apache-2.0; runs on your own Android 11+ phone.
- **No root, n

o constantly connected PC**: the runtime is on the phone.
- **Background virtual display**: third-pa

rty apps run on a scrcpy virtual display, leaving your main screen free.
- **Execution gates**: pay

/ send / delete / authorize controls are blocked by default.
- **Task ledger**: idempotent `task_id`

, stoppable execution, and refusal of new tasks when restart state is unknown.
- **Audit log**: reas

ons for allowed / refused actions, with on-device frame evidence.
- **Privacy**: gate vision checks

upload target-area crops only; clipboard-write receipts contain metadata, not clipboard plaintext.
-
**Local control-plane authentication**: the app command entry checks the sender's system permission

.
- **DSH + DeepSeek brain, with vision**: on-phone DSH does the understanding and reasoning, callin
g the DeepSeek API by default; other models are not yet covered by end-to-end validation or official

by default; other models are not yet covered by end-to-end validation or official support.
[该节后续省略]
## Why we compete on trust
Other projects compete on how smart they are. We compete on **how trustworthy delegation can be**. T
rust comes before delegation: hand off the chores, not your decisions.
| Why you can trust it | Engineering fact |
| **Risky decisions stay with you** | G1–G5 validate actions and retain evidence; R3 rechecks the fr

ame before dispatch. |
| **No duplicate work; can stop** | Tasks are idempotent by `task_id` and rep

ort stopped only after all execution processes are confirmed exited. |
| **Review what happened** |

The audit records action outcomes, allow / refuse reasons and frame evidence. |
| **Your main screen

stays yours** | Third-party apps use a scrcpy background virtual display by default. |
| **Goal: ot
her apps cannot take command** | `CmdReceiver` requires the sender to hold the `INJECT_EVENTS` syste
m permission; the installer attempts private ADB transport hardening by default and warns on preflig
ht skips rather than claiming hardening succeeded. |
A simpler life is the result; trustworthy delegation is the cause.
## What it can do today (verified on a real device, 2026-10-21)
All read-only, all on the virtual display, all through the gates:
- JD.com: status, order time and delivery info of the latest order (it can open the order detail pag

e)
- WeChat / Feishu (Lark): which conversations have unread messages, how many, and the last previe

w, **without opening any conversation**
- SMS: unread status (for verification codes it only says "t

here is one", never the digits)
- Chinese text input through clipboard receipts, with no plaintext l

s one", never the digits)
- Chinese text input through clipboard receipts, with no plaintext logging
Every task ends with a conclusion card: the answer, where it was read from, steps and time, and how
often the gates refused and why.

## Known limitations
- Pages that show dangerous words (e.g. an order list with a permanent "delete order" button) **cann

ot be scrolled**; only the first screen is read. This is the gate working as designed.
- Taps on pag
es without an accessibility tree rely on the vision model; the top/bottom edges of very tall buttons

are covered by vision only.
- After a reboot you must unlock the phone once before the system deliv

ers the boot broadcast.
- Speed depends on the model and the phone load: a task usually takes 2–8 mi
nutes, mostly spent waiting for the model.
